title: Correct full owner/bootstrap source selection and expose missing edges
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Correct three full-parent selection errors before a fresh original-view constructor can be built: the driver must be `integration/variant_driver_v1.py`, variant output must be derived from the session's `failure_variants/producer-output`, and the full parent requires ordered `group01` and `failure_variants` producers. Preserve the original runtime directory owners and separate normal/optimized command projections.

This completed scoped source/data audit records 21 exact source bodies (549,522 bytes), 284 typed dependency edges and 120 explicit unresolved frontiers. Source-load/compile/execution, injected namespace/capability and 33 receiver requirements are represented alongside imports. **The graph remains incomplete; runtime admission, C07, complete compiler-input closure, the bootstrap-control campaign, and original activity completion remain false.** No κ claim or original completion credit is added.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370), [PR #6377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6377).

Explicit user-assigned compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign prerequisite task, canonical handoff [PR6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6592212681). Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `2906d561f6fc5f68ba8f3863edfb91e2f63c8a43`, tree `62a997b51f91335b8eed3e6cb7db3a7ec092faea`.

Adapt [PR6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370) at `e144f3b0a440fd33efdcfa4e0bd1af059dfd4fb3`: its pinned-source/import/initialization AST method and matching inner bodies are useful; its 15-module acceptance is preserved within its original inner-body scope. Selected full-route snapshots come from [PR6377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6377) at `2a26450dea25d7648b585befce5ed375857a8f90`. The same-name older domain is not substituted.

[PR6374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6374), [6373](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6373) and [6371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6371) remain conditional prefix preparation/caller/entry dependencies. [6397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6397) supplies the unchanged direct two-build consumer scope; Group01's linked positive builds are not unioned into it. [6549](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6549) remains auxiliary guard evidence, not original caller qualification. Its unchanged controls were not rerun. Current all-state source-graph search covered 88/88 results; this bounded overlap check is not global novelty.

Scope is refined from the prior readiness gate to a non-admitting full-route source selection. Original criteria, denominators, caps and closed rounds remain unchanged. Source round closed 07:27:28 UTC before its fixed07:29:26 stop; publication supplies no extension or next research grant.

## Validation

Independent GPT-6.1-sol Max source/plan/wrapper and raw-result reviews are retained. Parent ran the exact reviewed new DATA/source checker once normal and once `-O`:15 unique cases, 30 observations, all matched independently fixed expectations, exit 0, empty stderr, identical stdout. One corrected proposal is source-only accepted; 14 mutations are rejected per mode, including wrong basename/output, missing producer/provider/receiver, wrong domain pin, fake authority and false completion claims.

Exact 28-file frozen package inventory, source hashes, plan and ordered oracle are checked before/after a cold copy. The standalone verifier is not qualified for arbitrary edited control plans. Parent wrapper bounds each run to 15 s wall/CPU, 1 GiB address space and 1 MiB file size. Measured child wall 1.067303602 s/1.167409446 s; CPU 1.030804 s/1.126169 s. Conservative debit 4 s; supplemental combined 113.890533479 s, canonical historical 94.550533479 s unchanged. Complete physical/preparation/review/Pro/publication/final metadata costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

Suggested reproduction in a fresh authorized checkout, after reading the exact review boundaries:
`python3 -B research/h25-full-owner-bootstrap-selection/validation/run_exact_reviewed.py`

Original source bodies are inert `.py.txt` and parsed as AST/text only. No original import, extracted original call, compiler/native/decoder/target inspection, original V01/bootstrap-control campaign or policy operation occurred. No VERIFY/TASK replay registration is added; any hosted planning checks must not be called scientific execution.

## Credit

Retain Chris R/Clear1nsight, Douglas R. Colkitt, repository/predecessor contributors including unpaidmoon/Cursor-Grok, and exact source notices/Apache-2.0 headers. Substantial Pro consultation, Codex and GPT-6.1-sol Max source implementation/independent review assistance is disclosed. AI review is not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Resolve the missing exact external full caller and Group01 payload/selection, then use this corrected manifest/creation boundary for a non-admitted fresh-view construction. Receiver/control/cold-authority bodies and unresolved source selectors remain explicit frontiers. Genuine capabilities, actual current C07 custody interval, complete original owner/bootstrap qualification checklist binding and complete compiler/header/specs/linker/library closure remain blockers before original two-mode qualification.

This archive does not complete compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign or resume the separately paused app goal.
